item.title: WICKED: FOR GOOD's Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed As Reviews Point To A Satisfying, "Stretched-Out" Finale
item.description: The first reviews for Wicked: For Good are positive, but not as glowing as those for Wicked. With these early verdicts comes a Rotten Tomatoes score, and that's so far falling short of its predecessor.

item.title: As More AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY AI Images Fool Fans, Are They Helping Or Hurting Marvel Studios?
item.description: As another round of Avengers: Doomsday images are proven to be fake, are these AI-generated "leaks" helping Marvel Studios preserve the surprise, or are the implications actually far more serious?

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Points To Reed Richards Having "A Lot Of Interactions" With Doctor Doom
item.description: Though Doctor Doom is expected to target Steve Rogers in Avengers: Doomsday, it sounds like we will still get to see the villain interact with his longtime comic book nemesis, Reed Richards...

item.title: DC Studios’ SUPERGIRL May Be The Best Indicator For Whether Or Not Audiences Have Had Enough Of Superheroes
item.description: Much has been said about comic book fatigue, but 2026 will be a particularly important year to gauge audience interest in superheroes. Perhaps the best project to determine that with will be Supergirl.

item.title: ONE WORLD UNDER DOOM #9 Leak Reveals First Look At Marvel's New Sorcerer Supreme - SPOILERS
item.description: Tomorrow will see the release of One World Under Doom #9, the final issue in Marvel Comics' latest event. However, an early look at the Scarlet Witch's transformation into the new Sorcerer Supreme is here!

item.title: Sony Reveals PlayStation Black Friday 2025 Deals On PS5 Consoles, Games, Accessories, And More
item.description: Sony's Black Friday 2025 sale will begin on November 21st, bringing discounts to PS5 console bundles and games, as well as accessories, peripherals, and more. Check out the deals below!

item.title: “I Don’t Believe I’m A Bad Person”: SMALLVILLE’s Allison Mack Talks NXIVM, Brandings, And Suicidal Thoughts
item.description: In a surprising move, Smallville actor Allison Mack went on Inside of You with former co-star Michael Rosenbaum to talk about her involvement with NXIVM and everything that stemmed from that.

item.title: THE BRIDE! BTS Image Teases Jessie Buckley's Transformation As Maggie Gyllenhaal Teases "Monstrous" Monsters
item.description: A new behind-the-scenes image from The Bride! shows us more of Jessie Buckley's transformation into the Bride of Frankenstein as filmmaker Maggie Gyllenhaal teases a bonkers, suitably monstrous take...

item.title: NIGHT PATROL: Defang The Police In First Trailer For Vampire Cop Thriller Starring Justin Long & CM Punk
item.description: Shudder has released the first trailer for a new vampire cop thriller titled Night Patrol, which stars Justin Long, Jermaine Fowler, RJ Cyler, Freddie Gibbs, and WWE's CM Punk...
